title: Atlas - AI Travel Companion
overview: An AI travel companion built on Anthropic's Claude SDK that plans a 10-day trip in about 2 minutes, remembers users across trips, and switches into GPS-aware companion mode while they are in-destination.
problem: Travel planning requires stitching together flights, hotels, places, weather, live nearby data, user preferences, and past trip context across many tools.
architecture: Atlas uses a Next.js frontend with a streaming chat API, an Express API on Render for user and trip CRUD, Neon Postgres for users, trips, conversations, profiles, and preferences, and a native Anthropic tool-use loop with strict schemas. Claude can call tools for flights, hotels, places, nearby open-now results, weather, preference memory, trip metadata updates, and itinerary composition while streaming every tool call to the UI over SSE.
technical_challenge: The hardest parts were preserving cross-trip memory, streaming Claude tool use clearly to the UI, validating every tool call with strict schemas, and making companion mode use trip dates plus geolocation to answer live in-destination questions like what is open nearby.
outcome: Built as a deployed full-stack travel companion with a Vercel frontend, Render API, Neon database, demo login, real-time streamed tool calls, cross-trip memory, and GPS-aware companion mode.

title: StaffIQ - Tutor Assignment Platform
overview: A full-stack tutor assignment platform for RMIT.
problem: Tutor selection and assignment needed structured workflows, admin reporting, and candidate ranking support.
architecture: The platform uses role-based auth, JWT, a GraphQL admin API, reporting dashboards, and Gemini AI for candidate ranking and resume insights.
technical_challenge: Combining admin workflows, AI ranking, and backend reporting in one system.
outcome: Built as a full-stack platform with role-based access and AI-assisted candidate evaluation.

title: Medico-Legal RAG System
overview: A RAG pipeline for medico-legal reports using LangGraph and FastAPI.
problem: Medico-legal report workflows can retrieve irrelevant context if all queries use one retrieval strategy.
architecture: A query router selects between three retrieval strategies before generating a response.
technical_challenge: Routing each query to the right retrieval strategy.
outcome: Portfolio claim: reduced irrelevant data retrieval by 75%.
